topic.bc01-the-book.speaker: hulm-tei
topic.bc01-the-book.prompt: Tell me about the estate's debt book.
lines: Every line of the estate's debt book is true. Rows-For-Another's food is in it. So is the boat's upkeep, and her sick days. An Owing is a debt paid in work. I name a buy-out by the book. I am a steward. I am not a slaver.
lines@low: Every line of the book is true. That is all I say to a stranger. Earn my regard and I will say more.
lines@high: I will speak plainly, because you have listened. Every line of the estate's debt book is true. Rows-For-Another's food is in it. So is the boat's upkeep, and her sick days. An Owing is a debt paid in work. I name a buy-out by the book. Nothing else sets it. Some call that slaving. I am a steward. I keep what is true.

topic.bc01-the-estate.speaker: never-sold
lines: Rows-For-Another took a boat from the estate north of Blackrose. She took it on an Owing of four months. An Owing is a debt paid in work. That was eleven years ago. She works it still. I have saved enough to buy out the Owing. Hulm-Tei, the steward, keeps the debt book in a locked chest on the landing. Take the swamp road north out of Blackrose. The landing is a short walk on, on the channel side, with boats at the water. I will meet you there.
lines@low: Rows-For-Another took a boat from the estate north of Blackrose. She owed four months' work. That was eleven years ago. She works it still. The steward keeps the debt book in a locked chest on the landing. Take the swamp road north. The landing is a short walk on, at the channel. More I tell to those I trust.
lines@high: Sit and hear it. Rows-For-Another took a boat from the estate north of Blackrose. She took it on an Owing of four months. An Owing is a debt paid in work. That was eleven years ago. She works it still. I have saved enough to buy out the Owing. Hulm-Tei, the steward, keeps the debt book in a locked chest on the landing. Take the swamp road north out of Blackrose. The landing is a short walk on, on the channel side, with boats at the water. I will meet you there. She talks of the channel after dark. It runs from the landing out of the estate's reach. She says she cannot drown in it. That frightens me. A rash act would fall on her. Bring me the book.

topic.bc01-bring-down.speaker: never-sold
topic.bc01-bring-down.prompt: I have the estate's debt book.
lines: That is the book. I will read her page. I do not argue the entries. I tear out her page and give it to her. Then I leave four months in coin in the steward's chest. That was the first price.
lines@low: That is the book. Stand back. I will do this myself, and I will not argue it with you.
lines@high: You have done what I could not. Give me the book. I will read her page. I do not argue the entries. I tear out her page and give it to her. Then I leave four months in coin in the steward's chest. That was the first price. It is paid. Rows-For-Another is free because of you.

topic.bc01-cut-loose.speaker: rows-for-another
lines: I will not wait on the book. Two estate men walk the landing at night. Past them, the channel runs out of the estate's reach. I cannot drown in it. Go first. I will follow you.
day: Not in daylight, with the men watching. Come back after dark. Then I will go with you.
lines@low: Two estate men walk the landing at night. The channel runs out of the estate's reach. I cannot drown in it. I follow you.
lines@high: I will not wait on the book any longer. Two estate men walk the landing at night. Pass them and the channel is open to us. It runs from the landing out of the estate's reach. I cannot drown in it. Go first. I will follow you.
day@low: Not in daylight, with the men watching. Come back after dark.
day@high: I want to go, but not in daylight, with the men watching. Come back after dark. I will be ready. I will go with you.
